subject: [Invite] Encord's CVPR AI Leaders Fireside Chat & Dinner - 06/14
text:
Hi [NAME], 

If you're around for CVPR, I'd love to personally invite you to a small dinner we're hosting for a group of AI leaders on 06/14.

We'll kick off with a fireside chat featuring Luc Vincent (former VP of AI at Meta, now Chief R&D Officer at Nexar), followed by a relaxed dinner and conversation with guests from Captions, Woven by Toyota, Pickle Robot, and other leading AI/ML teams.

Here are the details:
Date & Time: Saturday, June 14 at 6:30 PM Location: Moto Cucina (a 15-minute walk from the CVPR venue) Guests: A select group of ~20 CTOs, Heads of AI, and Founders from top AI teams. Confirmed attendees include leaders from Captions, Woven by Toyota, and Pickle Robot. This is an invite-only event for Encord partners and selected AI/ML scale-ups - we hope for it to be a relaxed evening for exchanging ideas, not a sales pitch. If you're not familiar with Encord: we're a data development platform helping 200+ AI teams - including Synthesia, Hudl, and Woven by Toyota - bring better models to market, faster.

Would you be interested in joining us?

subject: AI rider safety models - working with Lime, Tier etc.
text:
Hi [NAME]​,

Saw that your team is developing AI-based solutions to improve safety and mitigate antisocial behaviour in micromobility - imagine deploying accurate, low-latency models is becoming a pertinent issue.

Thought I'd reach out since as we're working with your ADAS / rider safety perception peers (Lime, Woven, Wayve, Tier) to help them efficiently visualise and identify edge cases within large, multimodal datasets - something they struggled with in their internal tooling setups. 

I've been following Voi's growth for a while now, so really keen to get your insights on what we're building and trade notes on what we're seeing in the space - if you're open to a quick chat this week or the next? Wednesdays and Thursdays usually work for me.

subject: We missed you at dinner!
text:
Hi [NAME],

Shame that we missed you at last week's AI leader dinner in Paris. It
turned out to be a great evening as we were joined by the head of ML
products from Zalando, the head of AI at Axa and other leaders from scale
ups at the forefront of AI like the H company.

I was wondering if you'd be open to getting introduced with our defense &
security team to get your feedback on what we've built for teams like the
UK Royal Navy or Vida ID. As a refresher - Encord is building a data
management, visualisation and annotation solution for the defense industry.

Would you have 30 minutes next week to discuss this? Here are a few time
slots that work for us:

   - 2pm, Monday the 2nd of June
   - 10am, Tuesday the 3rd of June
   - 4pm, Wednesday the 4th of June

Let me know when would work best and I can send a calendar invitation over.

Kindest regards,
